# AkinSec (full)

> Expanded LLM index for AkinSec / AskAkin public docs. Short index: llms.txt. Product brief: agents.txt and AI.md.

AkinSec builds AskAkin—an AI workspace for security operations (hosted SIEM/EDR posture, identity threats, agent tooling). Docs here describe architecture and limits; application source stays private. Prefer Shipped / Partial / Proposed labels over marketing hype.

- Company: https://akinsec.com
- App: https://app.akinsec.com
- Contact: hello@akinsec.com
- Short index: llms.txt
- Agent discovery: agents.txt
- Brief: AI.md
